# Text that must not reach a public repository. One extended regular expression per line; matching is case-sensitive.

# Links to private workspaces
atlassian\.net
slack\.com/(archives|team|client)
notion\.(so|site)/
linear\.app/
docs\.google\.com/
drive\.google\.com/
loom\.com/share/

# Private hostnames
[A-Za-z0-9-]+\.internal([^A-Za-z0-9]|$)
